title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode7 The Last Show

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
I got here way too early because I'm so nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And ended up coming here to try to relax a little...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I really hope they come see our show...)

Ichika...?
What are you doing here so early?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today's the day, but I ended up coming here because I'm so nervous. This place just has a way of putting me in the right state of mind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
So, do you feel ready?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all worked together to produce some really amazing music and lyrics, but there's no guarantee that we'll be able to reach those two...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you're still nervous, why don't we try singing it together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You went out of your way to come here, so we can do a quick warm-up together. How about it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But how's she able to do this? Whenever I hear Miku sing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Her voice... It makes my chest feel so warm...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're so amazing, Miku...
I can't believe how much better I feel after singing with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I didn't do anything.
I think this is your song's power.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The way you sing, Miku...
There's something special about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Singing with you has this uplifting effect too. It's like you're able to draw out my strengths somehow...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish we could sing together during our shows.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If that were possible...
I feel like we could touch so many people's hearts with our music.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, I'm over there already, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that other version of me is eagerly awaiting your arrival.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to go...
Sorry, Miku. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Hi, Yota...!
I'm so glad you're here!

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Yeah, sorry for making you wait...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Honestly, I thought you were gonna be a no-show! After Leo/need personally invited us too...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: True. Let's just make the most of today...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
Okay...
Even though this is gonna be our last show...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Let's have as much fun as we can...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, I can't see...
It's too dark...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, there they are!
Over in the corner!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
They're both here...
But they don't seem too happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Because this might be the last show they see together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (As much as they're suffering, all I can do for them now is sing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I can make this song hit home with them!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We need to play better than ever today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We have to make sure they can both move forward while cherishing all their happy memories.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we do that star thing Saki came up with?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Star pieces!
Aren't you ever gonna remember it right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, Ichika, you do the honors.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
For everyone who came to see us...
For Hanano and her brother...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've written a new song, so we'll be playing that along with our usual ones.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to play our best, so we hope you enjoy!!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (This is the first song Yota and I heard together here...)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (I sort of couldn't believe how it went either. It was like it was trying to cheer us up...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: (That was around the time Mom and Dad decided to get divorced. Hanano was so sad, but this put that spark back in her eyes...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: (And we were both smiling and laughing before either of us realized it...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Next, our new song.
We'll be playing it for the very first time here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Before we play it, please allow me to explain what this song means to us.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: All of us in this band have been friends since elementary school...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We used to play every day as kids from sunup to sundown.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But certain things happened that caused us to become estranged from each other...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And we ended up not really speaking to one another for almost two years...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Getting through that time wasn't easy...
It was almost unbearable... But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We felt true joy when we were able to get our band back together. It just became that much more meaningful.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This song... It's written for those who have to go through this sort of painful separation...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even though you won't be able to see each other, we want you to be able to move forward knowing that you have all these wonderful memories...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Why am I being reminded of all these things...?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
(Why's this happening...?
All of these memories of Yota and me are flooding back.)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: (That time he sat beside me until I fell asleep while Mom and Dad had this big argument...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: (How Hanano always made a birthday cake from scratch for me each year...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: (It always turned out a little funny because she wasn't much of a baker, but that's what made it special...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You two mean the world to each other, so I know it won't be easy being apart... But...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You won't be able to see each other, but I hope all of your wonderful memories help you find a way to move forward...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Good job, Ichika...
You really did your best.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks...
I was only able to because of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To hope that it reached them...
